comment: Project-only crypto review triggers. Off-chain stocks and personal-brokerage monitoring were retired 2026-10-06. The previous mixed watchlist is retained in notes/longterm_watchlist_archive_2026-10-06.md and Git history. A price trigger requests fresh thesis, lawful route, exact instrument identity, net-cost and portfolio-risk review; it never authorizes an automatic entry. Project positions must fit the less-than-one-year horizon and January 2027 evaluation.

Fresh CoinGecko UNI is $9.16 at22:04:40 UTC, above $3.25; no independently calibrated positive January excess-return case from configuration alone. The Sep-30 Arbitrum vetted-route cost observation is dated; revalidate lawful access, executable buy/sell depth, funding and gas before allocation. The $7.50 discussion level is not a replacement valuation gate.

Sep-30 evidence refresh: the $105 price gate is a review trigger, not an automatic buy. V4/Arc and Base stock launches already occurred. Require funded and executed recurring revenue-funded AAVE purchases with a disclosed cadence, plus a review of incident liabilities. April buyback pause is established, while August/September steward allowances for AAVE do not prove current recurring execution; do not assert that all present buybacks are zero without onchain verification. Arbitrum spot route is available through the hardened max-output/min-out gate, with a $20 round-trip quote loss of 0.612% before gas or funding.
